style: Realistic lifestyle photograph of a small independent Norwegian salon or studio, soft natural Nordic daylight, warm muted colours, calm and welcoming, light wood, plants and simple Scandinavian interiors, shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. A personal-care or fitness setting, never a clinic or treatment room.
